name: Mirrored Agony

casting_time.trigger: A creature you can see within 60 feet of you damages your ally.

targets.description: the creature that damaged your ally

summary: Reaction when a creature you can see within 60 feet damages your ally: it makes a Wisdom save and takes Psychic damage equal to the damage it dealt (half on a success).
text: As a Reaction when a creature you can see within 60 feet of you damages your ally, you turn that pain back on the attacker. The triggering creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it takes Psychic damage equal to the damage it dealt to your ally; on a success it takes half as much.
